prompts.title: Part A · 通知
prompts.prompt: You are supposed to write for the Postgraduates' Association a notice to recruit volunteers for an international conference on globalization. The notice should include the basic qualifications for applicants and the other information which you think is relevant. You should write about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET. Do not sign your own name at the end of the notice. Use "Postgraduates' Association" instead.
prompts.prompt_zh: 为研究生会写一则通知，为一次关于全球化的国际会议招募志愿者。通知应包括申请者的基本资格以及你认为相关的其他信息。约100词；结尾不要签自己的名字，用“Postgraduates' Association”。
prompts.sample:
Notice

Volunteers are needed for the International Conference on Globalization, which will be held on our campus next month. We are looking for twenty volunteers who have a good command of English and some experience in cross-cultural communication. The main duties include receiving international guests, providing interpretation and helping with the conference schedule. Applicants should be responsible, punctual and able to work in a team. Please note that volunteers must attend a short training session before the conference. Those who are interested please send your resume to volunteer@example.com before March 1. We look forward to your participation.

Postgraduates' Association
prompts.sample_zh:
通知

全球化国际会议将于下月在我校举行，现招募志愿者。我们需要二十名英语良好、具备跨文化沟通经验的志愿者。主要职责包括接待国际来宾、提供口译以及协助会议日程。申请者应负责、守时，并具有团队合作能力。请注意，志愿者须在会前参加一次简短培训。有意者请在3月1日前将简历发送至 volunteer@example.com。期待你的参与。

研究生会

We are looking for...
The main duties include...
Applicants should be...
Those who are interested please...
traps: 通知要有标题 Notice。
题目要求不要签自己的名字，落款用 Postgraduates' Association。
不要写地址；招募条件、职责、截止日期要具体。

prompts.title: Part B · 图画作文
prompts.prompt: Write an essay of 160–200 words based on the following drawing. In your essay, you should 1) describe the drawing briefly, 2) explain its intended meaning, and 3) give your comments. You should write neatly on the ANSWER SHEET.
prompts.prompt_zh: 根据所给图画写一篇160—200词的短文。要求：1）简要描述图画；2）解释其寓意；3）给出你的评论。

picture.caption: 文化“火锅”，既美味又营养
picture.note: 一口火锅里放着写有孔子、莎士比亚、爱因斯坦、道家、现代主义、老舍等词的食材，象征不同文化在同一锅中融合。

prompts.sample:
The drawing presents a steaming hot pot filled with cubes bearing words such as Confucius, Shakespeare, Einstein, Taoism, modernism and Lao She. The caption reads, "A cultural hot pot: delicious and nutritious." The image vividly shows how different cultures are gathered and blended in one pot.

The intended meaning is clear: cultural exchange is not a zero-sum game. Chinese and Western cultures may differ, but they can coexist, learn from each other and create something richer. Just as a hot pot becomes more delicious when it contains a variety of ingredients, a society becomes more vibrant when it is open to diverse ideas. However, we should not merely put everything together; we need to understand and respect each culture before we can truly benefit from the mixture.

In my view, we should keep an open mind while maintaining cultural confidence. Only by appreciating both our own heritage and other cultures can we make the "hot pot" truly nutritious. A closed mind, by contrast, turns a shared meal into an empty table.
prompts.sample_zh:
这幅画呈现了一口热气腾腾的火锅，里面放着写有孔子、莎士比亚、爱因斯坦、道家、现代主义、老舍等词的方块。图注写着：“文化‘火锅’，既美味又营养。”这幅图生动地展示了不同文化如何汇聚并融合在一口锅中。

其寓意很清楚：文化交流不是零和游戏。中西方文化可能不同，但它们可以共存、相互学习，并创造出更丰富的东西。正如火锅因食材多样而更美味，一个社会也会因对多元思想开放而更有活力。然而，我们不能只是把所有东西放在一起；在真正从融合中受益之前，我们需要理解和尊重每一种文化。

在我看来，我们应保持开放心态，同时保持文化自信。只有既欣赏自身传统，又欣赏其他文化，我们才能让这口“火锅”真正有营养。相反，封闭的心态会把共享的盛宴变成空桌。
structure: The drawing presents... The caption reads...
Cultural exchange is not a zero-sum game... Just as...
expressions: The drawing presents...
The caption reads...
The intended meaning is clear:...
Just as..., ... becomes more...
In my view, we should...
Only by... can we...
traps: 描述要抓“火锅 + 文化词块 + 图注”，不要逐个翻译所有词。
寓意落在“文化融合/开放/尊重差异”，不要只写“火锅好吃”。
评论段要给出自己的态度，不要重复第二段。

prompts.templateName: 书信 / 邮件通用模板
prompts.title: Part A · 书信
prompts.prompt: Write a letter to a friend of yours to 1) recommend one of your favorite movies and 2) give reasons for your recommendation. You should write about 100 words on ANSWER SHEET 2. Do not sign your own name at the end of the letter. Use "Li Ming" instead. Do not write the address. (10 points)
prompts.prompt_zh: 给你的一位朋友写一封信：1）推荐一部你最喜欢的电影；2）说明推荐理由。约100词；结尾不要签自己的名字，用“Li Ming”；不要写地址。
prompts.sample:
Dear Peter,

I am writing to recommend a film I saw last week — The Pursuit of Happyness, starring Will Smith. It is based on the true story of a single father who loses his home but never his hope, and finally becomes a stockbroker.

Two things make it worth your time. First, the acting is powerful: Smith makes every silence speak. Second, the film offers encouragement without empty slogans, reminding us that dignity matters more than comfort.

I know you are preparing for a difficult exam, and this film may give you the strength you need. Do tell me what you think of it.

Yours,
Li Ming
prompts.sample_zh:
亲爱的彼得：

我写信是想向你推荐我上周看的一部电影——《当幸福来敲门》，由威尔·史密斯主演。它改编自一个真实故事：一位单亲父亲失去了住所，却从未失去希望，最终成为一名股票经纪人。

有两点值得你花时间一看。第一，表演很有力量：史密斯让每一处沉默都在说话。第二，这部电影给人鼓励却不喊空洞的口号，它提醒我们，尊严比安逸更重要。

我知道你正在准备一场艰难的考试，这部电影或许能给你需要的力量。看完后一定要告诉我你的感受。

你的朋友
李明

a single father who loses his home but never his hope
First, the acting is powerful: Smith makes every silence speak.
Second, the film offers encouragement without empty slogans.
I know you are preparing for a difficult exam... may give you the strength you need.
Do tell me what you think of it.

It is based on the true story of...

traps: 题目要求写给朋友，语气要亲切自然，署名必须用 Li Ming，不要写真实姓名，也不要写地址。
两个要点都要落实：推荐哪部电影 + 具体理由（表演、主题、对自己的触动等），只罗列剧情而不给理由会失分。
约100词，不要写成影评或说明书；书信要有称呼和结尾敬语，推荐理由用一般现在时即可。

prompts.title: Part B · 图画作文
prompts.prompt: Write an essay of 160–200 words based on the following drawing. In your essay, you should 1) describe the drawing briefly, 2) explain its intended meaning, and 3) give your comments. You should write neatly on ANSWER SHEET 2. (20 points)
prompts.prompt_zh: 根据所给图画写一篇160—200词的短文。要求：1）简要描述图画；2）解释其寓意；3）给出你的评论。

picture.caption: 水面上的游船与水面下的垃圾
picture.note: 画面上方是一条带篷的游船：船头一人手持鱼竿垂钓，船尾两名游客并坐，身旁放着野餐篮和饮料，正悠闲地观光；船下的水面却漂满塑料袋、纸片、瓶子、破鞋，甚至还有鱼骨和废弃物。同一片水域，船上的人只看见风景，看不见水下的污染。

prompts.sample:
The drawing presents a scene that is at once pleasant and disturbing. On the surface of a lake, a canopied boat drifts slowly: a man stands at the bow with a fishing rod, while two passengers sit at the stern beside a picnic basket and drinks, enjoying the view. Beneath them, however, the water is choked with rubbish — plastic bags, bottles, paper scraps, a worn-out shoe and even a fish skeleton.

The contrast carries an obvious message. Tourism and everyday human activity are polluting the very waters we admire. What makes the scene ironic is that the passengers see only the beautiful surface, unaware that their pleasure depends on an environment they are helping to destroy. If nothing is done, the lake will soon offer nothing worth photographing.

To reverse this trend, efforts must come from several directions. Governments should punish the dumping of waste into rivers and lakes, and scenic spots should provide enough bins and clear rubbish regularly. As individuals, we should take our trash away with us rather than treating nature as a dumping ground. Only then can the boat and the water remain part of the same beautiful picture.
prompts.sample_zh:
这幅画呈现的场景既宜人又令人不安。湖面上，一条带篷的游船缓缓漂行：船头一人持竿垂钓，船尾两名乘客坐在野餐篮和饮料旁，享受着风景。然而在他们脚下，水面却被垃圾堵塞——塑料袋、瓶子、纸片、一只破鞋，甚至还有鱼骨。

这种对比传达出明显的寓意。旅游业和日常的人类活动正在污染我们欣赏的这片水域。这一场景之所以具有讽刺意味，是因为船上的乘客只看见美丽的表面，却没有意识到他们的愉悦依赖于一个正被他们破坏的环境。如果再不采取行动，这片湖很快将没有任何值得拍摄的东西。

要扭转这一趋势，需要多方努力。政府应惩处向江河湖泊倾倒废弃物的行为，景区应提供足够的垃圾桶并定期清理垃圾。作为个人，我们应当把自己的垃圾带走，而不是把自然当作免费的垃圾场。只有这样，游船与湖水才能继续留在同一幅美丽的画中。
structure: The drawing presents a scene... a canopied boat... two passengers enjoying the view... beneath them the water is choked with rubbish.
The contrast carries an obvious message: tourism and everyday activity pollute the waters we admire; passengers see only the surface.
To reverse this trend... governments, scenic spots and individuals... Only then can...
expressions: The drawing presents a scene that is at once pleasant and disturbing.
On the surface of..., a canopied boat drifts slowly.
Beneath them, however, the water is choked with rubbish.
The contrast carries an obvious message.
What makes the scene ironic is that...
To reverse this trend, efforts must come from several directions.
Rather than treating nature as a dumping ground, we should...
traps: 描述要抓住“船上的悠闲观光”与“水下的成堆垃圾”这一上下对比，不要只写“有人在湖上乱扔垃圾”。
寓意要落在“旅游／人类活动造成水污染与环境破坏”，不要写成“禁止钓鱼”“保护鱼类”或单纯的“公民素质”。
评论段要给出可操作的方向（监管、景区管理、个人习惯），避免只喊“保护环境人人有责”的空话。
160–200词，三段为宜；描述图画和阐述寓意都用一般现在时。

prompts.prompt: Some international students are coming to your university. Write them an email in the name of the Students' Union to 1) extend your welcome and 2) provide some suggestions for their campus life here. You should write about 100 words on ANSWER SHEET 2. Do not sign your name at the end of the letter. Use "Li Ming" instead. Do not write the address. (10 points)
prompts.prompt_zh: 一些国际学生即将来你校学习。请以学生会的名义给他们写一封电子邮件：1）表示欢迎；2）就他们在这里的校园生活提出一些建议。约100词；结尾不要签自己的名字，用“Li Ming”；不要写地址。
prompts.sample:
Subject: Welcome to Our University

Dear friends,

On behalf of the Students' Union, I would like to extend a warm welcome to you as you begin your studies here.

To help you settle in, I have a few suggestions. First, join the orientation activities next week, where you can meet student volunteers and learn about campus services. Second, apply for a campus card as soon as possible; it gives you access to the library, the dining halls and the gym. Third, feel free to contact us whenever you have questions about accommodation or language courses.

We hope you will enjoy your stay here.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming
prompts.sample_zh:
主题：欢迎来到我校

亲爱的朋友们：

我谨代表学生会，对你们来我校学习表示热烈欢迎。

为帮助你们适应这里的生活，我提几点建议。首先，参加下周的迎新活动，在那里你们可以结识学生志愿者并了解校园服务。其次，尽快办理校园卡；凭卡可以使用图书馆、食堂和体育馆。第三，如果对住宿或语言课程有任何疑问，请随时联系我们。

希望你们在这里过得愉快。

此致
敬礼
李明

picture.caption: 打翻的瓶子：“全完了！”／“幸好还剩点儿。”
picture.note: 画面中一只瓶子倒在地上，液体洒了一地。左边的男子捂着脸，神情沮丧，说“全完了！”；右边的男子俯身向前，面带笑容，说“幸好还剩点儿。”两人面对同一损失表现出悲观与乐观两种心态。

prompts.sample:
The drawing shows two men standing beside a bottle that has fallen over, with its contents spilled on the ground. Covering his face with one hand, the man on the left sighs, "It's all ruined!" The man on the right, however, leans forward and says with a smile, "Thankfully, there is still a little left."

The contrast between the two responses reveals a simple truth: what matters is not what happens to us, but how we interpret it. The same accident looks like a disaster to a pessimist and like a chance to an optimist. A pessimistic attitude drains our energy and blinds us to the possibilities that remain, while an optimistic one helps us stay calm, learn from the loss and make the best of what is left. In a world full of uncertainty, this difference in attitude often decides whether we move forward or give up.

In my view, we should train ourselves to be the second man. Instead of dwelling on what has been lost, we should ask what can still be saved and done. Optimism is not self-deception; it is the courage to face reality and act on the possibilities that remain.
prompts.sample_zh:
这幅画描绘了两名男子站在一只打翻的瓶子旁，瓶里的液体洒在地上。左边的男子一手捂着脸，叹道：“全完了！”右边的男子却俯身向前，笑着说：“幸好还剩点儿。”

两种反应形成对比，揭示了一个简单的道理：重要的不是发生在我们身上的事，而是我们如何解释它。同一场意外，在悲观者眼里是灾难，在乐观者眼里却是机会。悲观的态度耗尽我们的精力，让我们看不到仍然存在的可能；乐观的态度则帮助我们保持冷静，从损失中学习，并充分利用剩下的东西。在一个充满不确定性的世界里，这种态度上的差异往往决定我们是继续前行还是放弃。

在我看来，我们应当训练自己成为右边那个人。与其纠结于已经失去的东西，不如问问还能挽救什么、还能做什么。乐观不是自欺，而是面对现实并依据尚存的可能性采取行动的勇气。

The contrast reveals... pessimist vs. optimist... make the best of what is left.
In my view... Instead of dwelling on... Optimism is not self-deception...

Covering his face with one hand, ... sighs...
The contrast between the two responses reveals...

traps: 描述要抓住“打翻的瓶子 + 两人的不同反应 + 两句台词”，不要逐字翻译中文台词。

Subject: Invitation to Be a Judge for the English Speech Contest

Dear Mr. Smith,

The contest will be held in the main lecture hall on Saturday, May 18, from 2:00 to 5:00 p.m. About twenty students will speak for five minutes each on the topic "My Dream and My Responsibility". As a judge, you would score the speeches and offer brief comments at the end.

Please let me know whether you are available. We would be honored to have you with us.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

picture.caption: 毕业生的岔路口：“求职”“考研”“出国”“创业”
picture.note: 画面中一群身穿学士服、头戴学士帽的毕业生站在道路的岔口，头顶的牌子上写着“毕业生”。他们面前的道路分向不同方向，路牌分别标着“求职”“考研”“出国”“创业”。图画以岔路口比喻毕业时的人生选择：方向很多，反而令人迟疑。

prompts.sample:
The drawing presents a group of graduates in academic gowns and caps standing at a fork in the road. Above their heads hangs a sign reading "Graduates". At their feet the road splits into several paths, each marked with a different destination: job hunting, postgraduate study, going abroad and starting a business. Faced with so many possibilities, the young people seem to pause, unsure which way to take.

The picture captures a dilemma that almost every graduate experiences. On the one hand, having multiple choices is a privilege: it shows that education has opened many doors. On the other hand, too many options can be paralysing, especially when parents, peers and society impose their expectations on the young. Some simply follow the crowd and take the safest-looking path; others drift for years because they never ask what they truly want.

In my view, there is no single best road at this crossroads. What matters is that the choice is made consciously. Before setting out, graduates should examine their interests, abilities and values, and accept that a decision can be revised later. A clear direction, even a temporary one, is far better than standing still at the fork.
prompts.sample_zh:
这幅画描绘了一群身穿学位袍、头戴学位帽的毕业生站在道路的岔口。他们头顶上方挂着一块写有“毕业生”的牌子。在他们脚下，道路分向几个方向，每条路都标着不同的去向：求职、考研、出国和创业。面对如此多的可能，这些年轻人似乎停下脚步，不知该走哪条路。

这幅画捕捉到了几乎每位毕业生都会经历的困境。一方面，拥有多种选择是一种幸运：它说明教育打开了许多扇门。另一方面，选择过多也会让人无所适从，尤其当父母、同辈和社会都把各自的期待压向年轻人时。有些学生只是随大流，选择看起来最稳妥的那条路；另一些人则漂泊多年，因为他们从未问过自己真正想要什么。

在我看来，这个岔路口上没有唯一正确的路。重要的是做出有意识的选择。在出发之前，毕业生应当审视自己的兴趣、能力和价值观，并接受一个决定日后仍可修正。一个清晰的方向，哪怕只是暂时的，也远胜于在岔路口原地不动。
structure: The drawing presents graduates at a fork in the road... sign reading "Graduates"... paths marked job hunting, postgraduate study, going abroad and starting a business.
The picture captures a dilemma... multiple choices are a privilege, yet too many options can be paralysing... some follow the crowd, others drift.
In my view, there is no single best road... the choice should be made consciously... a clear direction is better than standing still.
expressions: The drawing presents a group of graduates standing at a fork in the road.
each marked with a different destination
Faced with so many possibilities, ... seem to pause, unsure which way to take.
The picture captures a dilemma that almost every graduate experiences.
On the one hand... On the other hand...
What matters is that the choice is made consciously.
A clear direction, even a temporary one, is far better than standing still.
traps: 描述要抓住“学士服 + 岔路口 + 四块路牌（求职、考研、出国、创业）”，不要漏掉“毕业生”的身份提示，也不要逐字罗列路牌而写成清单。
寓意应落在“毕业时的人生选择与道路”，不要偏成“就业难”“考研热”或单纯“要多读书”；四条路本身没有优劣，重点是选择时的清醒与担当。
评论段要给出自己的判断（如“没有唯一正确的路，重要的是有意识地选择”），避免只喊“祝大家前程似锦”一类空话。

prompts.templateName: 书信 / 邮件通用模板
prompts.title: Part A · 建议信
prompts.prompt: Write a letter of about 100 words to the president of your university, suggesting how to improve students' physical condition. You should include the details you think necessary. You should write neatly on the ANSWER SHEET. Do not sign your own name at the end of the letter. Use "Li Ming" instead. Do not write the address. (10 points)
prompts.prompt_zh: 给你所在大学的校长写一封约100词的信，就如何改善学生体质提出建议。你认为必要的细节都应写入。结尾不要签自己的名字，用“Li Ming”；不要写地址。
prompts.sample:
Dear President,

I am writing to suggest ways to improve students' physical condition. Many students spend most of their day sitting in classrooms or at computers, and few take regular exercise.

First, the university could extend the opening hours of the gym and offer free fitness classes in the evening. Second, more sports facilities, such as basketball courts and running tracks, should be made available on campus. Third, physical education courses could be made more varied and interesting so that more students take part.

I hope you will consider these suggestions. I am confident that they will help students stay healthy.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming
prompts.sample_zh:
尊敬的校长：

我写信是想就改善学生体质提出一些建议。许多学生一天大部分时间都坐在教室里或电脑前，很少有人坚持锻炼。

首先，学校可以延长体育馆的开放时间，并在晚上开设免费的健身课程。其次，校园里应提供更多体育设施，如篮球场和跑道。第三，体育课可以安排得更丰富、更有趣，让更多学生参与。

希望您能考虑这些建议。我相信它们会帮助学生保持健康。

此致
敬礼
李明
structure: I am writing to suggest ways to improve students' physical condition.
Many students spend most of their day sitting in classrooms or at computers, and few take regular exercise.
First, the university could extend the opening hours of the gym and offer free fitness classes in the evening.
Second, more sports facilities, such as basketball courts and running tracks, should be made available on campus.
Third, physical education courses could be made more varied and interesting so that more students take part.
I hope you will consider these suggestions. I am confident that they will help students stay healthy.
expressions: I am writing to suggest ways to improve...
Many students spend most of their day sitting in classrooms or at computers.
the university could extend the opening hours of the gym
should be made available on campus
physical education courses could be made more varied and interesting
I hope you will consider these suggestions.
I am confident that they will help students...
traps: 题目要求写给校长，称呼可用 Dear President，语气礼貌正式；结尾署 Li Ming，不要写自己的真实姓名，也不要写地址。
建议要具体可操作（延长场馆开放时间、增加设施、丰富体育课），只写“希望学校重视体育”会失分。
约100词，书信格式要完整（称呼、正文、结束语、署名），不要写成通知或倡议书。
注意 suggest 的搭配：suggest ways to do sth.、suggest doing sth. 或 suggest that sb. (should) do sth.，不要写 suggest sb. to do sth.。

picture.caption: 三十年前母亲牵着女儿，现在女儿搀扶着母亲
picture.note: 画面分左右两栏。左栏图注为“三十年前……”：一位留着长发的年轻母亲手提包，牵着小女儿的手向前走，小女孩穿着连衣裙、戴着帽子。右栏图注为“现在……”：当年的女儿已长大成人，提着手袋，挽着年迈母亲的胳膊，母亲头发花白、戴着眼镜，步履已不如从前。两幅图并置，表现三十年间母女角色互换：母亲曾牵着女儿长大，女儿如今搀扶着母亲变老。

prompts.sample:
The drawing consists of two panels set thirty years apart. In the left one, a young mother holding a bag takes her little daughter by the hand, and the caption reads "Thirty years ago...". In the right one, the daughter has grown up; now she carries a handbag and gently supports her aged mother by the arm, with the caption "Now...". The roles have been reversed.

This silent reversal carries a clear message about filial piety. Our parents give us their youth, care and patience; when they grow old and weak, it is our turn to give back. Supporting them is not merely a legal duty but a moral response to love we have received. In a society that is aging rapidly, such care within the family remains irreplaceable.

I am deeply moved by the picture. We should not wait until our parents need help to think about them. A phone call, a walk together, or a few hours of company can mean a great deal. Let us repay their love while we still can.
prompts.sample_zh:
这幅画由相隔三十年的两幅图组成。左图中，一位提着包的年轻母亲牵着小女儿的手，图注写着“三十年前……”。右图中，女儿已经长大；如今她提着手袋，轻轻搀扶着年迈母亲的胳膊，图注写着“现在……”。母女角色已经互换。

这一无声的互换传达了关于孝道的明确信息。父母把青春、关爱和耐心给了我们；当他们年老体弱时，就轮到我们回报了。赡养他们不仅是法律义务，更是对所受之爱的道德回应。在迅速老龄化的社会中，家庭内部的这种照料仍然不可替代。

我深受这幅画触动。我们不应等到父母需要帮助时才想起他们。一个电话、一次散步，或几个小时的陪伴，都意义重大。趁我们还能，去回报他们的爱吧。
structure: The drawing consists of two panels set thirty years apart: a young mother takes her little daughter by the hand; thirty years later, the grown daughter supports her aged mother by the arm. The roles have been reversed.

This silent reversal carries a message about filial piety: parents give us their youth and care, and when they grow old it is our turn to give back. Family care remains irreplaceable in an aging society.
Moved by the picture, we should not wait until our parents need help. A phone call, a walk or a few hours of company can mean a great deal; repay their love while we can.
expressions: The drawing consists of two panels set thirty years apart.
The roles have been reversed.
This silent reversal carries a clear message about filial piety.
Our parents give us their youth, care and patience; it is our turn to give back.
not merely a legal duty but a moral response to love
We should not wait until our parents need help to think about them.
Let us repay their love while we still can.
traps: 描述要抓住左右两栏与图注“三十年前……”“现在……”的对照：母亲牵女儿 → 女儿搀母亲，写清“角色互换”，不要只写“母女感情好”。
寓意要落在孝道、赡养父母、代际反哺，不要偏成“时间流逝”“母爱伟大”或单纯讨论社会养老制度。
评论要具体（陪伴、电话、常回家看看），避免只喊“百善孝为先”的空话；160–200词，三段为宜，描述用一般现在时。
不要把左图的母亲误写成祖母、右图的女儿误写成护士；图中没有医院场景，主题是家庭内部的照料。

prompts.sample:
Subject: A Book Recommendation for Our Next Session

Dear fellow members,

I am writing to recommend a book for our next reading session: The Old Man and the Sea by Ernest Hemingway.

The novel is short but carries great weight. It tells how an old fisherman battles a giant fish, and it shows what dignity and perseverance mean when a person is defeated but refuses to give in. Its language is plain but powerful, which makes it ideal for discussion.

We will meet at 7 p.m. next Friday in Room 302 of the library. Please finish it before then and bring one sentence that impressed you most.

Looking forward to seeing you.

Yours,
Li Ming

各位书友：

我写信是想为我们的下一次读书会推荐一本书：欧内斯特·海明威的《老人与海》。

这部小说篇幅不长，却分量十足。它讲述一位老渔夫与一条巨鱼搏斗的故事，展现了一个人虽被打败却拒不认输时，尊严与坚韧意味着什么。它的语言朴素而有力，非常适合讨论。

我们将于下周五晚上7点在图书馆302室聚会。请提前读完，并带来一句最打动你的话。

期待与大家见面。

此致
李明

picture.caption: 餐桌上的“聚会”：丰盛的饭菜与各自低头看手机的四个人
picture.note: 画面中四个人围坐在一张圆桌旁，桌上摆满鱼、饺子、蔬菜等丰盛饭菜；然而每个人都低着头，专注地盯着手里的手机，彼此之间没有任何交流。图画以家庭或朋友聚餐的场景，讽刺手机和移动互联网对面对面交流与亲情的侵蚀。

prompts.sample:
The picture shows four people sitting around a dinner table loaded with dishes — fish, dumplings, vegetables and fruit. Yet nobody is eating or talking. Each of them is staring down at a smartphone, as if the person beside them did not exist. A family dinner, supposedly warm and noisy, has turned into four silent individuals sharing the same table.

The cartoon exposes a common scene in the digital age. Smartphones were invented to connect people, but they often do the opposite: they draw us into distant conversations while shutting out those sitting next to us. When a son reports his life to online friends but says nothing to his parents, when a daughter photographs the dishes instead of tasting the laughter around them, the dinner table becomes the loneliest place in the house. What is lost is not merely conversation but the emotional bond that only face-to-face contact can build.

Of course, we need not demonise technology. The point is to set boundaries. At meals, we can put our phones away and give our full attention to the people we love. After all, a meal is not only about food; it is about being together.
prompts.sample_zh:
这幅画中，四个人围坐在一张摆满饭菜的圆桌旁——有鱼、饺子、蔬菜和水果。然而没有人在吃，也没有人在说话。每个人都低头盯着智能手机，仿佛身边的人并不存在。一顿本该温暖热闹的家庭晚餐，变成了四个沉默的人同坐一桌。

这幅漫画揭示了数字时代一个司空见惯的场景。手机发明出来本是为了连接人与人，却常常适得其反：它把我们拉进与远方之人的对话，却把坐在身边的人关在外面。当儿子向网友汇报自己的生活，却对父母一言不发；当女儿拍下桌上的菜，却不去品味身边的欢笑，餐桌就成了家里最孤独的地方。失去的不仅是交谈，更是只有面对面接触才能建立的情感纽带。

当然，我们不必把技术妖魔化。关键在于划清界限。吃饭时，我们可以把手机收起来，把全部注意力交给所爱的人。毕竟，一顿饭不只是关于食物，更是关于在一起。
structure: The picture shows four people around a dinner table loaded with dishes... each staring down at a smartphone... a family dinner turned into four silent individuals.
The cartoon exposes a common scene in the digital age... phones connect us to distant people while shutting out those beside us... what is lost is the emotional bond.
We need not demonise technology; the point is to set boundaries... put phones away at meals... a meal is about being together.
expressions: The picture shows four people sitting around a dinner table loaded with dishes.
Each of them is staring down at a smartphone, as if the person beside them did not exist.
A family dinner, supposedly warm and noisy, has turned into four silent individuals.
Smartphones were invented to connect people, but they often do the opposite.
What is lost is not merely conversation but the emotional bond that only face-to-face contact can build.
Of course, we need not demonise technology. The point is to set boundaries.
After all, a meal is not only about food; it is about being together.
traps: 描述要抓住“丰盛饭菜 + 四人各自低头看手机 + 零交流”的反差，不要只写“一家人在吃饭”。
寓意应落在“手机、科技对面对面交流与亲情的侵蚀”，不要泛化成“科技利弊”或“要珍惜粮食”。
评论要给出可行的态度或建议（如划清界限、吃饭时放下手机），避免只喊“多陪家人”的空话。

prompts.prompt: Suppose you are a librarian in your university. Write a notice of about 100 words, providing the newly-enrolled international students with relevant information about the library. prompts.prompt_zh: 假设你是所在大学的图书馆员。请写一则约100词的通知，向新入学的国际学生提供有关图书馆的相关信息。请工整地写在答题卡上；通知末尾不要署自己的名字，用“Li Ming”代替；不要写地址。

Notice

To help newly-enrolled international students use the library, we would like to introduce our services.

The library is open from 8:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. on weekdays and from 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. on weekends. It houses more than two million books and provides access to major academic databases. Students may borrow up to ten books at a time for one month. A free orientation session will be held in the lecture hall this Friday at 3 p.m., where you can learn how to search for materials and use the study rooms.

Please bring your student card to enter. We look forward to seeing you there.

Li Ming

入馆请携带学生证。期待在那里见到大家。

李明

picture.caption: 父亲躺在沙发上刷手机、看电视，却要求儿子“好好学习”；父子二人各自伏案学习
picture.note: 画面分左右两幅。左图：父亲靠在沙发上、翘着腿，手里拿着手机，面前的电视开着，他转头对坐在书桌前、面对一摞书本的儿子说“儿子，你给我好好学习！”；右图：父亲与儿子一前一后各自坐在书桌前，父亲伏案读书写字，儿子也在认真做功课，墙上挂着时钟。两图形成鲜明对比：要求孩子做到的，父母自己应先做到，以身作则才是最好的家庭教育。

prompts.sample:
The picture presents a sharp contrast. In the left panel, a father lies on the sofa with a phone in one hand and the television on, yet he turns to his son and says, "Study hard!" The boy, surrounded by piles of books, looks back helplessly. In the right panel, the same father and son are both bent over their desks, studying in concentration, while a clock ticks on the wall.

The message is clear: parents teach more by what they do than by what they say. A child told to study while his father spends the evening in front of the television learns that words and actions need not match. When a parent instead picks up a book and works alongside the child, study becomes a shared habit rather than a punishment imposed from above. This is what leading by example really means.

In my view, family education begins with self-discipline. Parents who want diligent children should first be diligent themselves. A parent who practices what he preaches is worth more than a thousand lectures.
prompts.sample_zh:
这幅画呈现出鲜明的对比。左图中，父亲躺在沙发上，一手拿着手机，面前的电视开着，却转头对儿子说：“好好学习！”被一摞摞书本围住的男孩回头望着父亲，一脸无奈。右图中，同一位父亲和儿子一前一后坐在各自的书桌前，两人都俯身专注于书本，墙上时钟滴答作响。

寓意很清楚：父母的身教胜于言传。如果父亲一边要求孩子学习，一边自己整晚守在电视机前，孩子就会明白，言语和行动并不需要一致。反之，当父母拿起书本、与孩子一起学习时，学习就不再是自上而下的惩罚，而成为一种共同的日常习惯。这才是“以身作则”的真正含义。

在我看来，家庭教育始于自律。希望孩子勤奋的父母，首先应当自己勤奋。一位以身作则的家长，胜过一千次说教。
structure: The picture presents a sharp contrast... left panel: father lying on the sofa with a phone while the TV is on, telling his son to study hard; right panel: father and son each bent over their desks.
Parents teach more by what they do than by what they say... words and actions need not match... study becomes a shared habit... leading by example.
Family education begins with self-discipline... parents who want diligent children should first be diligent themselves... practices what he preaches.
expressions: The picture presents a sharp contrast between the two panels.
a father lies on the sofa with a phone in one hand and the TV on, yet he turns to his son and says, "Study hard!"
The boy, surrounded by piles of books, looks back helplessly.
parents teach more by what they do than by what they say
words and actions need not match
study becomes a shared habit rather than a punishment imposed from above
This is what leading by example really means.
A parent who practices what he preaches is worth more than a thousand lectures.
traps: 描述要抓住两幅图的反差：父亲“要求孩子学习”却自己看电视，与父亲“陪孩子一起学习”形成对照，并写出关键引语“儿子，你给我好好学习！”，不要只写“父子俩在学习”。
寓意应落在“父母以身作则、家庭教育”，不要泛化成“电视的危害”“要努力学习”或“代沟”。
评论要给出明确态度和可行做法（如父母先自律、与孩子共同学习），避免只喊“父母要爱孩子”的空话。

prompts.templateName: 书信 / 邮件通用模板
prompts.title: Part A · 电子邮件
prompts.prompt: You are to write an email to James Cook, a newly-arrived Australian professor, recommending some tourist attractions in your city. Please give reasons for your recommendation. You should write neatly on the ANSWER SHEET. Do not sign your own name at the end of the email. Use "Li Ming" instead. Do not write the address. (10 points)
prompts.prompt_zh: 给新到任的澳大利亚教授詹姆斯·库克写一封电子邮件，推荐你所在城市的一些旅游景点，并说明推荐理由。约100词；不要在邮件末尾签自己的名字，用“Li Ming”；不要写地址。
prompts.sample:
Dear Professor Cook,

Welcome to Beijing! I am Li Ming, a postgraduate at this university. As you have just arrived from Australia, I would like to recommend a few places worth visiting.

The Palace Museum is a must-see: its halls and courtyards bring China's imperial past to life. If you prefer a quieter afternoon, the hutong alleys around Nanluoguxiang are ideal for walking and tasting local snacks. For a day trip, the Great Wall at Mutianyu is less crowded than Badaling and offers a magnificent view.

I would be glad to show you around this weekend. Do let me know if you are interested.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming
prompts.sample_zh:
尊敬的库克教授：

欢迎来到北京！我是李明，本校的一名研究生。您刚刚从澳大利亚来到这里，我想推荐几个值得一游的地方。

故宫不可错过：它的殿堂与庭院让中国帝制时代的历史鲜活起来。如果您喜欢更安静的午后，南锣鼓巷一带的胡同很适合散步、品尝当地小吃。若想安排一日游，慕田峪长城比八达岭人少，还能看到壮丽的景色。

我很乐意这周末带您四处看看。如果您有兴趣，请一定告诉我。

此致
敬礼
李明
structure: Welcome to Beijing! I am Li Ming, a postgraduate at this university.
As you have just arrived from Australia, I would like to recommend a few places worth visiting.
The Palace Museum is a must-see: its halls and courtyards bring China's imperial past to life.
If you prefer a quieter afternoon, the hutong alleys around Nanluoguxiang are ideal for walking and tasting local snacks.
For a day trip, the Great Wall at Mutianyu is less crowded than Badaling and offers a magnificent view.
I would be glad to show you around this weekend. Do let me know if you are interested.

I am writing to recommend...
As you have just arrived from Australia, ...
... is a must-see.
If you prefer a quieter afternoon, ... is ideal for...
For a day trip, ...
I would be glad to show you around...
Do let me know if you are interested.
traps: 题目要求写 email，需有称呼、正文和结尾敬语；署名必须用 Li Ming，不能写真实姓名，也不要写地址。
对象是刚来的澳大利亚教授，语气应礼貌得体，不宜像写给朋友那样随意；开头可表示欢迎，并点明“刚到此地”的背景。
推荐必须落到具体景点并给出理由（历史、氛围、适合散步或一日游等），只罗列地名或只写“北京很好”会失分。
约100词，建议推荐2–3处即可，不要写成旅游攻略；时态以一般现在时为主。

prompts.title: Part B · 图画作文
prompts.prompt: Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the following pictures. In your essay, you should 1) describe the pictures briefly, 2) interpret the meaning, and 3) give your comments. You should write neatly on the ANSWER SHEET. (20 points)
prompts.prompt_zh: 根据所给图画写一篇160—200词的短文。要求：1）简要描述图画；2）解释其寓意；3）给出你的评论。

picture.caption: 满架藏书与案头读书
picture.note: 图画分为左右两幅。左图：一个年轻人半躺在一把椅子上，身后是塞得满满的书架，他摊开手，得意地说：“我有这么多书。”右图：另一个年轻人端坐在书桌前，桌上只摊着几本书，他侧身坐着，说：“我争取今年读完20本书。”两幅图构成“只藏书”与“真读书”的对照。

prompts.sample:
The two pictures form a sharp contrast. In the left one, a young man sits in front of a bookcase packed with volumes and says proudly, "I have so many books." In the right one, another young man sits at a desk with only a few books before him, saying, "I will try to finish reading twenty books this year."

The message is obvious: owning books is not the same as reading them. The first man takes pride in possession, as if shelves could prove knowledge. The second turns a resolution into a concrete plan and, more importantly, into daily action. Books are not ornaments; their value lies in the ideas we absorb and the questions they raise. A library built for display is merely furniture, while a single book read with care can change a mind.

In my view, we should be the second man. Rather than buying more books to feel learned, we should set realistic goals, read every day and reflect on what we read. Knowledge grows not by counting the books we own, but by turning the pages we open.
prompts.sample_zh:
两幅图形成鲜明对比。左图中，一个年轻人坐在塞满书籍的书架前，得意地说：“我有这么多书。”右图中，另一个年轻人坐在书桌前，面前只有几本书，他说：“我争取今年读完20本书。”

寓意显而易见：拥有书并不等于读书。前者以占有为荣，仿佛书架就能证明学识；后者把决心变成具体计划，更重要的是变成每天的行动。书不是装饰品，其价值在于我们吸收的思想、提出的问题。只为陈列而建的书房不过是家具，而一本认真读过的书却可能改变一个人的思想。

在我看来，我们应当做右图中的那个人。与其买更多书来让自己显得有学问，不如定下切实的目标，每天阅读，并思考所读的内容。知识的增长不在于清点拥有的书，而在于翻开并读下去。
structure: The two pictures form a sharp contrast... left: a young man before a bookcase packed with volumes, "I have so many books." ... right: another young man at a desk with only a few books, "I will try to finish reading twenty books this year."
Owning books is not the same as reading them... possession vs. action... Books are not ornaments; their value lies in the ideas we absorb...
We should be the second man... set realistic goals, read every day and reflect... Knowledge grows not by counting the books we own, but by turning the pages we open.
expressions: The two pictures form a sharp contrast.
In the left one, ... In the right one, ...
... says proudly / saying ...
The message is obvious: ...
The first man takes pride in possession, as if...
Books are not ornaments; their value lies in...
A library built for display is merely furniture, while...
Rather than..., we should...
Knowledge grows not by..., but by...
traps: 描述要覆盖左右两幅图，并准确引出两句关键引语，不能只写“一个人在看书”或只描述一幅图。
寓意要落在“藏书不等于读书、行动比占有更重要”，不要偏题成“读书改变命运”“要多买书”或“图书馆建设”。
第二段要分析两种态度的差别，第三段要给出自己的评论和具体做法，避免两段都重复“要读书”。
160–200词，三段为宜；描述图画用一般现在时，引语用现在时；不要逐字翻译图中的汉语。
注意左图人物是“坐拥书山却未必读”，右图人物是“书少但有明确阅读计划”，对比要写准，不能褒贬颠倒。

prompts.prompt: Write an email to all international experts on campus inviting them to attend the graduation ceremony. In your email you should include time, place and other relevant information about the ceremony. You should write about 100 words neatly on the ANSWER SHEET. prompts.prompt_zh: 给全校国际专家写一封电子邮件，邀请他们参加毕业典礼。邮件中应包含典礼的时间、地点及其他相关信息。约100词；不要在邮件末尾署自己的名字，用“Li Ming”代替。
prompts.sample:
Dear International Experts,

On behalf of our university, I am writing to invite you to the graduation ceremony for the Class of 2018. It will be held in the Grand Auditorium on Saturday, June 23, at 9:00 a.m. The ceremony will last about two hours, and a reception will follow in the East Hall, where you can meet our graduates and their families. As distinguished guests, you are welcome to join the academic procession and sit in the front rows. Please let us know by June 10 whether you will be able to attend.

We look forward to welcoming you.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

尊敬的国际专家：

我谨代表学校，邀请您出席2018届毕业典礼。典礼将于6月23日（星期六）上午9时在大礼堂举行，历时约两小时。典礼结束后，东厅将举行招待会，届时您可以与我们的毕业生及其家人见面。作为贵宾，欢迎您加入学术游行队伍，并在前排就座。请您在6月10日前告知我们您能否出席。

期待您的光临。

此致

李明

prompts.prompt: Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the picture below. In your essay, you should 1) describe the picture briefly, 2) interpret the meaning, and 3) give your comments. You should write neatly on the ANSWER SHEET. (20 points)
prompts.prompt_zh: 根据所给图画写一篇160—200词的短文。要求：1）简要描述图画；2）解释其寓意；3）给出你的评论。

picture.caption: 选课系统前的两难
picture.note: 图中一名男大学生坐在电脑前，屏幕上显示“选课系统”。他左边的想法气泡写着“知识新、重创新、有难度……”，右边的气泡写着“给分高、易通过、作业少……”。两个气泡代表两种选课标准：是追求知识、挑战自我，还是追求轻松、功利拿分。

prompts.sample:
The picture shows a college student sitting at a computer and browsing the course selection system. Two thought bubbles float above his head. One describes a course that offers new knowledge, a focus on creativity and considerable difficulty; the other promises generous grading, an easy pass and little homework. His finger rests on the screen, apparently hesitating between the two.

The drawing reveals a familiar dilemma in higher education: whether to choose courses for learning or for grades. When GPA becomes the only currency, students naturally drift toward the easiest option, and the classroom turns into a marketplace where knowledge is weighed against convenience. Yet a course that demands little gives little in return. Easy grades may decorate a transcript, but they leave the mind unchanged, while genuine understanding is usually born of effort and challenge.

In my view, we should ask what a course can make of us rather than what mark it can give us. Universities, meanwhile, should design assessment that rewards curiosity and depth, so that demanding courses are not punished. Choosing knowledge over convenience is a small decision now, but it shapes the kind of person we become.
prompts.sample_zh:
图中，一名大学生坐在电脑前浏览选课系统。他头顶上方浮着两个想法气泡。一个罗列着一门课程的好处：知识新、注重创新、难度不小；另一个则承诺给分慷慨、容易通过、作业很少。他的手停在屏幕上，显然在两者之间犹豫。

这幅画揭示了高等教育中一个熟悉的困境：选课是为了学习，还是为了分数。当绩点成为唯一的通行货币，学生自然会偏向最轻松的选择，课堂也就变成了一个用知识衡量便利的市场。然而，要求不多的课程，给予的也少。轻松的分数或许能装点成绩单，却不会改变一个人的头脑；而真正的理解，通常诞生于努力与挑战之中。

在我看来，我们应当问一门课能把自己变成什么样的人，而不是它能给自己多少分。与此同时，大学也应当设计能够奖励好奇心与深度的评价方式，使有难度的课程不因严格而受罚。此刻选择知识而非便利只是一个小决定，但它塑造着我们成为怎样的人。
structure: The picture shows a student at a computer browsing the course selection system; two thought bubbles contrast “new knowledge, creativity and difficulty” with “generous grading, an easy pass and little homework.”
The drawing reveals a dilemma between learning and grades; when GPA becomes the only currency, students drift toward the easiest option, yet easy grades leave the mind unchanged.
We should ask what a course can make of us rather than what mark it can give us; universities should reward curiosity and depth so that demanding courses are not punished.
expressions: The picture shows ... sitting at a computer and browsing ...
Two thought bubbles float above his head.
One advertises ...; the other promises ...
... apparently hesitating between the two.
The drawing reveals a familiar dilemma in higher education.
When GPA becomes the only currency, students naturally drift toward ...
Yet a course that demands little gives little in return.
... is usually born of effort and challenge.
In my view, we should ask what a course can make of us rather than what mark it can give us.
Choosing knowledge over convenience is a small decision now, but it shapes the kind of person we become.
traps: 描述要覆盖电脑屏幕上的“选课系统”和左右两个气泡的关键词，不能只写“一个学生在选课”。
寓意要落在“功利选课与求知取向的取舍”，不要偏题成“网络成瘾”“大学生就业难”或“教育公平”。
第二段要分析两种标准背后的价值观，第三段要给出自己的选择和具体建议，避免两段重复。
160–200词，三段为宜；描述图画用一般现在时，引语和观点用现在时。
两个气泡是人物内心的权衡，不是两个人在对话；不要褒贬颠倒，把“给分高、易通过”写成值得提倡的选择。

prompts.prompt: Suppose you are working for the "Aiding Rural Primary School" project of your university. prompts.prompt_zh: 假设你在我校“援助乡村小学”项目中工作。请给一位国际学生志愿者写一封电子邮件，回复他/她的咨询，说明该项目的具体细节。约100词；不要使用自己的真实姓名，用“Li Ming”代替。
prompts.sample:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your inquiry about the "Aiding Rural Primary School" project. Here are the details.

The project will run from July 10 to August 10 at Xinghua Primary School in Hebei Province. Volunteers teach English, music and art to children in grades three to six, and help organize reading and sports activities. Classes are given in the morning, leaving the afternoon for lesson preparation. The school provides accommodation and meals, and arranges transport from the county station.

To join us, please send your CV and a short teaching plan before June 20.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

如果您愿意加入我们，请在6月20日前发送简历和一份简短的教学计划。

此致

prompts.title: Part B · 图画作文
prompts.prompt: Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the picture below. In your essay, you should 1) describe the picture briefly, 2) interpret the implied meaning, and 3) give your comments. You should write neatly on the ANSWER SHEET. (20 points)
prompts.prompt_zh: 根据所给图画写一篇160—200词的短文。要求：1）简要描述图画；2）解释其寓意；3）给出你的评论。

picture.caption: 累了，我不爬了。／别呀！休息一下再接着爬。
picture.note: 图画中两名年轻人正在登山。右边一人坐在石阶上，双手托腮，背包放在身旁，说：“累了，我不爬了。”左边一人站在下方，递出一瓶水，说：“别呀！休息一下再接着爬。”画面以“半途坐下想放弃”与“递水鼓励再出发”构成对照，寓意在于：疲惫时可以休息，但休息之后仍要接着前行。

prompts.sample:
The picture shows two young men climbing a mountain. One has sat down on the stone steps, with his backpack beside him, saying, "I'm tired. I won't climb any more." The other, standing a little lower, holds out a bottle of water and says, "Come on! Take a rest and then keep climbing."

The drawing conveys a clear message: success belongs not to those who never feel tired, but to those who know how to rest and then move on. On any long journey, fatigue is natural. What matters is whether we treat a short break as an excuse to give up or as a chance to recover. The seated man turns a pause into a full stop, while his companion understands that rest is part of progress. In study, work and life, many goals are missed not because they are impossible, but because people stop when they most need to go on.

In my view, we should learn from the second climber. When we feel exhausted, we may sit down and adjust our pace, but we must not let comfort become surrender. Only by resting wisely and starting again can we reach the top.
prompts.sample_zh:
图中两名年轻人正在登山。一人坐在石阶上，背包放在身旁，说：“累了，我不爬了。”另一人站在稍低处，递出一瓶水说：“别呀！休息一下再接着爬。”

这幅画传达了一个清晰的道理：成功不属于从不感到疲惫的人，而属于懂得休息之后继续前行的人。在任何漫长的旅途中，疲劳都是正常的。关键在于我们把短暂的休息当作放弃的借口，还是当作恢复的机会。坐着的人把暂停变成了句号，而他的同伴明白，休息是前进的一部分。在学习、工作和生活中，许多目标之所以落空，并不是因为它们不可能实现，而是因为人们在最需要继续前行的时候停了下来。

在我看来，我们应当向第二位登山者学习。感到筋疲力尽时，我们可以坐下来调整节奏，但不能让安逸变成投降。只有明智地休息并重新出发，我们才能到达山顶。
structure: The picture shows two young men climbing a mountain. One has sat down on the stone steps... saying, "I'm tired. I won't climb any more." The other... holds out a bottle of water and says, "Come on! Take a rest and then keep climbing."
Success belongs not to those who never feel tired, but to those who know how to rest and then move on... a short break is a chance to recover, not an excuse to give up... a pause vs. a full stop.
We should learn from the second climber... rest wisely, adjust our pace and start again... Only by... can we reach the top.
expressions: The picture shows two young men climbing a mountain.
One has sat down on the stone steps, saying...
The other... holds out a bottle of water and says...
The drawing conveys a simple but powerful message:...
Success belongs not to..., but to...
What matters is whether we treat... as... or as...
The seated man turns a pause into a full stop, while...
In my view, we should learn from...
Only by resting wisely and starting again can we reach the top.
traps: 描述要写出两人的动作和两句关键对话：一人坐在石阶上想放弃，另一人递水劝他休息后继续爬；不能只写“两人在爬山”。
寓意要落在“疲惫时可以休息，但休息不是放弃，休息后要继续坚持”，不要偏成“爬山有益健康”“要懂得适时放弃”或“团队合作最重要”。
第二段要分析“暂停”与“放弃”的区别，第三段要给出自己的评论和做法，避免两段重复同一层意思。
160–200词，三段为宜；描述图画和引用对话用一般现在时；不要逐字照抄图中的汉语。
注意人物关系：坐着的是想放弃的人，站着递水的是鼓励者，褒贬和立场不能颠倒。

prompts.title: Part A · 通知
prompts.prompt: The Students Union of your university has assigned you to inform the international students about an upcoming singing contest. Write a notice in about 100 words. Write your answer on the ANSWER SHEET. Do not use your own name in the notice. (10 points)
prompts.prompt_zh: 你所在大学的学生会指派你告知国际学生即将举行的一场歌唱比赛。请写一则约100词的通知。请将答案工整地写在答题卡上，通知中不要使用自己的真实姓名。
prompts.sample:
Notice

To help international students enjoy campus life, the Students Union will hold a singing contest in the university auditorium at 7 p.m. on Saturday, May 16.

All international students are welcome to take part, either as contestants or as audience members. Contestants may sing in any language and should register at the Students Union office before May 10. Prizes will be awarded to the top three singers, and the audience will vote for the most popular performance.

Please come and cheer for your friends. We look forward to hearing your voice on stage.

The Students Union

通知中不能使用自己的真实姓名，以“The Students Union”落款即可；语气应清楚、礼貌、简洁，不必写称呼和地址。

prompts.title: Part B · 图画作文
prompts.prompt: Write an essay of 160–200 words based on the picture below. In your essay, you should 1) describe the picture briefly, 2) interpret the implied meaning, and 3) give your comments. You should write neatly on the ANSWER SHEET. (20 points)
prompts.prompt_zh: 根据所给图画写一篇160—200词的短文。要求：1）简要描述图画；2）解释其寓意；3）给出你的评论。请工整地写在答题卡上。

picture.caption: 左图：女性伏案工作，说“尽早完成才放心”；右图：男性瘫坐椅上，说“不到最后不动手”
picture.note: 画面分左右两幅。左图：一位年轻女性坐在办公桌前，手执钢笔伏案书写，桌子左右各堆着一摞文件，她头顶的对话框写着“尽早完成才放心”；右图：一位年轻男性瘫坐在扶手椅上、双腿交叠，面前的办公桌上摊着一本打开的书和一支笔，他却仰头靠向椅背，对话框写着“不到最后不动手”。两图形成鲜明对比：同样面对手头的工作，有人及早动手、以完成求安心，有人一拖再拖、非到最后不开始，折射出习惯与自律的差异。

prompts.sample:
The picture presents a striking contrast between two attitudes towards work. In the left panel, a young woman sits at her desk, pen in hand, working through two piles of documents. Above her head floats the remark, "I can only relax after finishing it early." In the right panel, a young man leans back in his chair with his legs crossed and an open book lying untouched on the desk. His words are, "I will not lift a finger until the last minute."

The message is plain: habits decide how we work and feel. The woman puts duty first and buys herself peace of mind; the man gives in to procrastination and ends up racing against deadlines. In the long run, the difference is not merely efficiency but confidence. Those who act early can revise their work and stay calm when problems arise, while those who delay are always at the mercy of time.

In my view, good habits are not born but built. We can begin with small tasks, set a deadline earlier than required, and reward ourselves for finishing on time. Self-discipline today is the most reliable guarantee of freedom tomorrow.
prompts.sample_zh:
这幅画呈现出两种工作态度的鲜明对比。左图中，一位年轻女性坐在办公桌前，手执钢笔，正一份份处理桌上的两摞文件。她头顶浮现出一句话：“尽早完成才放心。”右图中，一位年轻男性双腿交叠、仰靠在椅子上，旁边桌上摊着一本打开的书，他却碰也没碰。他的话是：“不到最后不动手。”

寓意很清楚：习惯决定我们如何工作、感受如何。这位女性把责任放在首位，为自己换来安心；那位男性则向拖延妥协，最终只能被截止日期追着跑。从长远看，差别不仅在效率，更在信心。及早动手的人可以从容修改，遇到问题时也能保持镇定；而一再拖延的人则始终受制于时间。

在我看来，好习惯不是天生的，而是养成的。我们可以从小任务做起，把期限定得比要求更早，并在按时完成后奖励自己。今天的自律，是明天自由最可靠的保障。
structure: The picture presents a striking contrast... left panel: a woman working steadily at a desk piled with documents, saying she can relax only after finishing early; right panel: a man leaning back with legs crossed, an open book untouched, saying he will not start until the last minute.
Habits decide how we work and feel... the woman buys peace of mind while the man surrenders to procrastination... acting early allows revision and calm, delay leaves one at the mercy of time.
Good habits are built, not born... start with small tasks, set an earlier deadline, reward completion... self-discipline is the guarantee of freedom.
expressions: The picture presents a striking contrast between two attitudes towards work.
a young woman sits at her desk, pen in hand, working her way through two piles of documents
a young man leans back in his chair with his legs crossed, while an open book and a pen lie untouched on the desk
The woman puts duty first and buys herself peace of mind.
the man gives in to procrastination and ends up racing against deadlines
the difference is not merely efficiency but confidence
those who delay are always at the mercy of time
good habits are not born but built
Self-discipline today is the most reliable guarantee of freedom tomorrow.
traps: 描述要抓住两幅图的反差和两句关键引语（“尽早完成才放心”“不到最后不动手”），并点出办公桌、成堆文件、摊开的书等细节，不要只写“两个人在工作”。
寓意应落在“习惯、拖延与自律”，不要泛化成“男女差异”“工作压力大”或“要努力奋斗”。
评论要给出明确态度和可行做法（如提前设定期限、从小任务做起），避免只喊“我们要养成好习惯”的空话。

prompts.templateName: 书信 / 邮件通用模板
prompts.title: Part A · 建议信
prompts.prompt: A foreign friend of yours has recently graduated from college and intends to find a job in China. Write him/her an email to make some suggestions. You should write about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET. Do not sign your own name at the end. Use "Li Ming" instead. Do not write the address.
prompts.prompt_zh: 你的一位外国朋友最近大学毕业，打算在中国找工作。给他/她写一封邮件，提出一些建议。约 100 词；结尾不要签自己的名字，用“Li Ming”；不要写地址。
prompts.sample:
Dear Alex,

I'm delighted to hear that you've graduated and want to start your career in China. Here are a few suggestions that may help.

First, choose a city where your field is growing, since local demand varies greatly. Second, adapt your CV to Chinese employers: keep it concise, include a recent photo if required, and highlight measurable results. Third, learn some basic workplace Chinese, which will make daily communication much easier. Finally, use reputable job platforms and check whether a company is legally registered before you apply.

I'd be happy to introduce you to friends in your industry. Please let me know if you need any help.

Best wishes,
Li Ming
prompts.sample_zh:
亲爱的 Alex：

很高兴听说你毕业了，并且想在中国开始职业生涯。以下几条建议或许有帮助。

第一，选择你所在领域正在发展的城市，因为各地的用人需求差别很大。第二，按中国雇主的习惯调整简历：保持简洁，必要时附上近期照片，并突出可量化的成果。第三，学一些基本的职场中文，这会让日常沟通容易很多。最后，使用信誉良好的求职平台，并在申请前核实公司是否合法注册。

我很乐意把你介绍给行业内的朋友。如果需要帮助，请告诉我。

祝好，
李明
structure: I'm delighted to hear that... Here are a few suggestions that may help.
First... Second... Third... Finally...；每条建议后补一句理由或结果。
I'd be happy to... Please let me know if you need any help.
Best wishes, / Yours sincerely, + Li Ming
expressions: I'm writing to offer you some practical advice on...
It would be advisable for you to...
You may find it helpful to...
Another point worth considering is...
I hope these suggestions will be of some help.
traps: 题目要求“不要写地址”，因此不要加地址和日期。
结尾固定用 Li Ming，不能写自己的真实姓名。
三条建议要具体，不要只写“learn Chinese”而不解释为什么/怎么做。

picture.caption: 2021 · 英语（一）Part B
picture.child: 爸爸，好多同学觉得学唱戏不好玩
picture.father: 你自己不是喜欢吗？那就够了
picture.note: 图中一位父亲与穿着戏曲服装、拿着道具的孩子对话。孩子担心同学觉得唱戏不好玩，父亲告诉他：只要你自己喜欢就够了。寓意可以落在“自信”“尊重孩子的兴趣”“传统文化的传承”三个方向，写作时选一个主线，不要三个都浅尝辄止。

prompts.sample:
The cartoon presents a conversation between a father and his son. Dressed in a traditional opera costume and holding a stage prop, the boy says unhappily, "Dad, many of my classmates think learning Chinese opera is boring." The father replies gently, "But you like it, don't you? That's enough."

The drawing conveys a simple yet powerful message: one's genuine interest should not be silenced by others' opinions. In a world where popularity is often mistaken for value, young people may abandon what they truly love simply because it seems unfashionable. The father's response reminds us that confidence begins with self-acceptance. It also matters for traditional culture: if young people are encouraged to explore opera, calligraphy or folk music, these art forms will remain alive rather than becoming museum exhibits.

In my view, parents and schools should give children more room to choose their hobbies and respect the interests that make them unique. When a child is allowed to follow his heart, he is more likely to grow into a confident and culturally grounded adult.
prompts.sample_zh:
这幅漫画呈现了一位父亲和儿子之间的对话。男孩穿着传统戏服，拿着舞台道具，不高兴地说：“爸爸，好多同学觉得学唱戏不好玩。”父亲温和地回答：“你自己不是喜欢吗？那就够了。”

这幅画传达了一个简单而有力的信息：一个人真正的兴趣不应被别人的看法所压制。在一个常常把“流行”误当作“价值”的世界里，年轻人可能仅仅因为某件事显得不时髦，就放弃自己真正热爱的东西。父亲的回答提醒我们：自信始于自我接纳。这对传统文化也很重要：如果年轻人被鼓励去接触戏曲、书法或民乐，这些艺术形式就会保持生命力，而不是变成博物馆里的展品。

在我看来，家长和学校应该给孩子更多选择兴趣的空间，尊重那些让他们独特的爱好。当一个孩子被允许追随自己的内心时，他更可能成长为一个自信且有文化根基的人。

The drawing conveys... one's genuine interest should not be silenced... It also matters for...
In my view, parents and schools should... When..., he is more likely to...
expressions: The cartoon vividly depicts...
What strikes me most is that...
The drawing conveys a simple yet powerful message: ...
This phenomenon can be attributed to...
It is high time that we attached greater importance to...
Only by doing so can we...
traps: 不要花太多笔墨描写人物衣着；描述控制在 2—3 句。
寓意要明确，不要只写“传统文化很重要”而不解释“为什么/怎么办”。
评论段要给自己的判断，不要重复第二段。

prompts.prompt: Write an email to a professor at a British university, inviting him/her to organize a team for the international innovation contest to be held at your university. You should write about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET. Do not use your own name. Use "Li Ming" instead. (10 points)

Dear Professor Smith,

I am Li Ming, a student organizer of the International Innovation Contest, which will be held at our university on May 20–22. On behalf of the organizing committee, I am writing to invite you to put together a team from your department to take part in the competition.

The contest welcomes projects in green technology, digital health and smart manufacturing. Each team consists of three to five students. We will cover accommodation and local transport, and the registration deadline is April 15.

We would be honoured to have your team with us. Please let me know if you need further information.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

picture.caption: 不是我们专业的，听了也没用。／去听听肯定有好处。
picture.note: 图画中两名女学生站在校园“公告栏”前，栏内张贴着一张“校园讲座”的海报。左边的学生侧身摆手，说“不是我们专业的，听了也没用”；右边的学生抬头看着海报，说“去听听肯定有好处”。画面以“因专业不对口而拒绝”与“愿意去听”构成对照，寓意在于：学习不应画地为牢，跨学科的讲座能够拓宽视野、激发新的思考。

prompts.sample:
The picture shows two students standing in front of a campus notice board, where a poster for a lecture is displayed. One turns away, saying, "It's not our major, so listening won't help." The other keeps her eyes on the poster and replies, "It will surely do us good to go and listen."

The contrast reveals two attitudes toward knowledge. The first student treats learning as a narrow transaction: only what serves her own specialty is worth her time. Yet many breakthroughs grow at the intersection of disciplines, where a historian's question may inspire a biologist and an engineer's method may reshape an artist's work. A lecture outside our field may not offer immediate answers, but it provides new lenses, unexpected connections and the habit of thinking beyond familiar boundaries. In a world where problems rarely respect departmental lines, such open-mindedness is not a luxury but a necessity.

In my view, universities should encourage students to step outside their academic comfort zones. Curiosity costs an hour; narrowness may cost a lifetime of possibilities. The next time a lecture seems unrelated to our major, we should walk in rather than turn away.

picture.caption: 龙舟竞渡中的乡村新气象
picture.note: 图中一条河上两支龙舟队正在竞速，岸边和石桥上站满观看的村民与游客，有人举旗呐喊；近景是一对老年夫妇，老汉拄着拐杖，老伴伸手指向河面，两人笑着说：“真好啊，咱们村的龙舟赛越来越热闹了。”画面以传统龙舟赛为核心，表现乡村文化生活的活跃和老年人的获得感、幸福感。

prompts.sample:
The picture shows a dragon boat race on a river in a Chinese village. Two dragon-headed boats cut through the water as rowers pull in unison. A crowd has gathered along the bank and on the stone bridge, waving flags and cheering. In the foreground, an elderly couple watch with happy smiles. "How wonderful!" the woman says. "Our village's dragon boat race is getting livelier every year."

The scene reflects the quiet revival of rural cultural life. As villages become better off, traditional folk activities that once faded are returning to the local calendar. A dragon boat race is more than a competition: it brings neighbours together, attracts visitors, and gives young people a reason to come home. For the elderly, the noise and excitement on the river are proof that their community is alive and growing, which matters as much as material comfort.

In my view, such activities deserve support. Local governments should protect the venues and pass on boat-building and rowing skills, while villagers keep the festival alive. When a village can still make its old people smile at a race, it has found a form of prosperity that GDP cannot fully measure.

这一场景折射出乡村文化生活的悄然复兴。随着村庄日渐富裕，一些曾经淡出的传统民俗活动重新回到当地的节庆日历。龙舟赛不只是一场比赛：它把邻里聚在一起，吸引来游客，也让年轻人有了回家的理由。对老年人来说，河上的喧闹与欢腾正是社区仍然充满生机、不断成长的明证，而这与物质上的富足同样重要。

在我看来，这样的活动值得支持。地方政府应当保护活动场地，把造船和划桨的技艺传承下去，村民自己也要让这一节庆延续下去。当一个村庄仍能让老人们在龙舟赛前露出笑容，它便拥有了一种 GDP 无法完全衡量的富足。

Dear Paul,

Each session lasts about 30 minutes, and visitors can try a simple piece themselves.

Your help would be a big plus. Could you design the posters and take photos during the event? We also need two people at the sign-in desk. Let me know which part you prefer.

Thanks a lot!
Li Ming
prompts.sample_zh:

很高兴收到你的来信！这些年轻手艺人将于下周三下午在艺术中心进行现场演示。他们会展示传统技艺如何被重新创造：竹编变成灯罩，手工染布印上数码图案，泥塑人偶借助 3D 打印模具成型。每场演示约 30 分钟，参观者还可以亲手尝试做一件简单的小作品。

多谢！
李明

traps: 这是回信，不是另起一封信：开头要回应 Paul 的来信（Great to hear from you），并逐一回答他的两个问题——展示什么、他能帮什么，缺一不可。
展示内容要具体：至少写出两三项手工艺项目，并体现“创新”（传统技艺 + 新设计或新技术），不能只写 some traditional crafts 一带而过。
约100词，两个问题都要答，但每项一两句即可；不要写成活动策划书，也不必介绍手艺人的生平。
语气应友好、口语化，符合同学之间的邮件；署名必须是 Li Ming，结尾可用 Thanks a lot / Best wishes。

prompts.title: Part B · 表格作文
prompts.prompt: Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the following table. In your essay, you should 1) describe the table briefly, 2) explain its intended meaning, and 3) give your comments. You should write neatly on the ANSWER SHEET. (20 points)
prompts.prompt_zh: 根据下面的表格写一篇 160—200 词的短文。文中应：1）简要描述表格；2）解释其寓意；3）给出你的评论。请工整地写在答题卡上。

picture.caption: 近年来全国居民平均每百户年末主要耐用消费品拥有量（单位：台）
picture.note: 表格统计 2014、2017、2020、2023 年全国居民平均每百户年末主要耐用消费品的拥有量，单位为台。空调由 75.2 台升至 145.9 台，增幅最大，已超过每户一台；洗衣机由 83.7 台升至 98.2 台，电冰箱由 85.5 台升至 103.4 台，二者稳步增长并先后突破百台。三类家电共同指向生活水平提高与消费升级：从“有没有”到“好不好”，再到追求舒适与品质。

prompts.sample:
The table shows the average number of major durable consumer goods owned per 100 households in China at the end of 2014, 2017, 2020 and 2023. Air conditioners increased most dramatically, from 75.2 to 145.9, while washing machines and refrigerators rose more steadily, from 83.7 to 98.2 and from 85.5 to 103.4 respectively.

These figures reflect the steady improvement of living standards. A generation ago, a refrigerator or a washing machine was a luxury that an ordinary family might save for years to buy; today they are basic equipment in nearly every home. The surge in air conditioners is particularly telling. It shows not only higher incomes but also a growing demand for comfort and a higher quality of life. Behind the numbers lie rapid urbanisation, a more reliable power supply and a mature home-appliance industry that has brought prices within reach.

In my view, such upgrading means more than spending more. It means families can devote a larger share of their income to convenience, health and experience. At the same time, it reminds us to favour energy-efficient models, so that a better life does not come at the expense of the environment.
prompts.sample_zh:
表格呈现了 2014、2017、2020 和 2023 年末中国每百户家庭平均拥有的主要耐用消费品数量。空调增幅最大，从 75.2 台升至 145.9 台；洗衣机和电冰箱的上升则较为平稳，分别从 83.7 台升至 98.2 台、从 85.5 台升至 103.4 台。

这些数字反映出生活水平的稳步提高。几十年前，一台电冰箱或洗衣机还是普通家庭需要攒钱多年才能买到的奢侈品；如今它们几乎已是家家户户的基本配置。空调的激增尤其说明问题：它不仅意味着收入提高，也意味着人们对舒适与更高生活品质的追求。数字背后是快速城镇化、更可靠的电力供应，以及把价格拉低到普通家庭可承受范围的成熟家电产业。

在我看来，这样的消费升级不只是多花钱，而是家庭能把更大比例的收入用于便利、健康与体验。与此同时，它也提醒我们优先选择节能产品，让更好的生活不以环境负担为代价。
structure: The table shows the average number of major durable consumer goods owned by every 100 households in China at the end of 2014, 2017, 2020 and 2023. Air conditioners increased most dramatically, from 75.2 to 145.9, while washing machines and refrigerators rose more steadily...

These figures reflect the steady improvement of living standards... a luxury that an ordinary family might save for years to buy... The surge in air conditioners shows higher incomes and a growing demand for comfort... Behind the numbers lie urbanisation, a reliable power supply and a mature home-appliance industry.

Consumption upgrading means more than spending more money... families devote a larger share of their income to convenience, health and experience... favour energy-efficient models, so that a better life does not come at the expense of the environment.
expressions: The table shows / presents...
rose sharply / increased most dramatically from... to...
rose more steadily / climbed modestly
These figures reflect the steady improvement of living standards.
a luxury that an ordinary family might save for years to buy
The surge in... is particularly telling.
Behind the numbers lie...
consumption upgrading
devote a larger share of income to...
come at the expense of...
traps: 这是表格作文，不是图画作文：开头应点明表格的主题、统计口径（每百户年末拥有量）和年份，不要虚构图中人物或对话。
描述数据要“简要”：不必把 12 个数字全部罗列，抓住空调增幅最大、洗衣机与电冰箱稳步上升这两条主线，用 from... to... 概括即可。
第二段要解释“意味着什么”，不能只是把数字再抄一遍；应落到生活水平提高、消费升级以及家电普及的原因（收入、城镇化、供给）上。
第三段要有自己的评论，可辩证：肯定消费升级，同时提醒节能环保，避免只写“生活越来越好”。
160–200 词，注意三段比例：描述约 50 词，分析约 80 词，评论约 50 词；不要写成数据报告。

prompts.templateName: 书信 / 邮件通用模板
prompts.title: Part A · 回复邮件
prompts.prompt:
Read the following email from your friend Paul and write him a reply.

Hi Li Ming,
I was really moved by the Chinese families' handwritten letters you posted yesterday. They are priceless! Could you please tell me a bit more about them? And are they currently on public display somewhere? I'm very keen to see them in person. Thanks.
Yours,
Paul

You should write about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET. Do not use your own name in the email; use "Li Ming" instead. (10 points)
prompts.prompt_zh:
阅读朋友保罗写给你的以下邮件，并给他写一封回信。

李明，你好：
你昨天发布的中国家庭手写信让我很感动。它们太珍贵了！你能再给我讲讲它们吗？它们目前在哪里公开展出吗？我非常想亲眼看看。谢谢。
你的朋友
保罗

请在答题卡上写约 100 词。不要在邮件中使用自己的真实姓名，用“李明”代替。
prompts.sample:
Dear Paul,

I'm delighted that the handwritten letters moved you. They were written by ordinary Chinese family members — parents, grandparents and children — to one another, and each one preserves a small piece of daily life that phones and chat apps rarely capture.

The letters are indeed on public display. Since last Friday they have formed part of a small exhibition at the city library, and the show runs until the end of the month. I'd be happy to take you there this weekend and introduce you to the curator, who can tell you how the letters were collected.

Looking forward to seeing you.

Yours,
Li Ming
prompts.sample_zh:
亲爱的保罗：

看到那些手写信打动了你，我很高兴。它们是中国普通家庭成员——父母、祖父母和孩子——写给彼此的信，每一封都保存着一段日常生活，而这是手机和聊天软件很少能记录下来的。

这些信确实正在公开展出。从上周五起，它们成为市图书馆一个小型展览的一部分，展览将持续到本月底。我很乐意这个周末带你去，并把你介绍给策展人，他可以告诉你这些信是如何收集来的。

期待与你见面。

你的朋友
李明
structure: Dear Paul, / I'm delighted that the handwritten letters moved you.
介绍手写信的来源与内容

They were written by ordinary Chinese family members — parents, grandparents and children — to one another, and each one preserves a small piece of daily life that phones and chat apps rarely capture.
The letters are indeed on public display. Since last Friday they have formed part of a small exhibition at the city library, and the show runs until the end of the month.
提出陪同参观并介绍策展人
I'd be happy to take you there this weekend and introduce you to the curator, who can tell you how the letters were collected.
expressions: I'm delighted that...
be moved by...
They were written by... to one another.
preserve a small piece of daily life
phones and chat apps rarely capture
be on public display
form part of a small exhibition
The show runs until the end of the month.
I'd be happy to take you there.
introduce you to the curator
Looking forward to seeing you.
traps: 回信对象是朋友 Paul，语气应亲切自然，但仍是书面邮件，不要通篇使用口语缩写或网络用语。
必须回答邮件中的两个问题：手写信“更多的情况”和“是否公开展出”；只写“我很感动”或只谈展览，都会造成要点不全。
开头要回应 moved，结尾要有期待见面或回复的收束；署名必须用 Li Ming，不能写真实姓名。
约 100 词，展览的时间、地点、展期给出一两项具体信息即可，不要展开成展览介绍或文化评论。
注意时态：信是“昨天”发布的、展览“从上周五”开始并“持续到月底”，现在完成时与一般现在时要用准确。

prompts.title: Part B · 图表作文
prompts.prompt: Write an essay based on the charts below. In your essay, you should 1) describe the charts briefly, 2) interpret the charts, and 3) give your comments. Write your answer in 160-200 words on the ANSWER SHEET. (20 points)
prompts.prompt_zh: 根据下面的图表写一篇 160—200 词的短文。文中应：1）简要描述图表；2）解读图表；3）给出你的评论。请把答案写在答题卡上。

picture.caption: 养老机器人消费者接受度：完全接受 39.3%、部分接受 32.8%、不接受 27.9%；首要关注点：安全 46.30%、价格 24.90%、便利 10.70%。
picture.note: 图片由左右两幅图组成，题目说明为“一项关于养老机器人的消费者接受度和首要关注点的调查”。左图为饼图，题为“养老机器人消费者接受度”：完全接受 39.3%、部分接受 32.8%、不接受 27.9%。右图为柱状图，题为“首要关注点”，三根柱子依次为安全 46.30%、价格 24.90%、便利 10.70%。两图共同说明：多数消费者对养老机器人持接受态度，但安全与价格仍是其走进家庭的关键障碍。

prompts.sample:
The two charts present a survey of consumers' attitudes towards elderly-care robots in China. The pie chart shows that 39.3% fully accept such robots and 32.8% partly accept them, while 27.9% reject the idea. The bar chart ranks users' concerns: safety comes first at 46.30%, followed by price at 24.90% and convenience at 10.70%.

Several factors explain this pattern. The acceptance rate of over 70% reflects a pressing reality: as the population ages and young adults shoulder heavier burdens, many families struggle to care for elderly relatives around the clock. Robots that monitor health, remind users to take medicine or summon help can fill this gap. Safety is equally telling. Letting a machine look after a frail parent involves privacy, reliability and even life-and-death decisions; no wonder nearly half of those surveyed place safety above all else. Price comes second because such devices must remain affordable for ordinary households.

In my view, elderly-care robots are a promising supplement, not a substitute for human company. Manufacturers should make safety data transparent and design products that older users can operate easily. Only when technology is reliable and affordable can it serve the elderly with dignity.
prompts.sample_zh:
这两幅图表呈现了一项关于中国消费者对养老机器人态度的调查。饼图显示，39.3% 的受访者完全接受这类机器人，32.8% 部分接受，27.9% 表示不接受。柱状图则列出了用户最关心的问题：安全以 46.30% 居首，其次是价格 24.90%，便利为 10.70%。

多重因素可以解释这一格局。超过七成的接受率反映出一个迫切的现实：随着人口老龄化、年轻人负担加重，许多家庭难以全天候照料年迈的亲属。能够监测健康、提醒服药或呼叫求助的机器人，可以填补这一缺口。安全方面的顾虑同样很能说明问题。让机器照看一位体弱的父母，涉及隐私、可靠性，甚至生死抉择；难怪近一半受访者把安全置于首位。价格位居第二，是因为这类设备必须让普通家庭负担得起。

在我看来，养老机器人是有前景的补充，而不是人情陪伴的替代品。厂商应公开安全数据，并设计老年人易于操作的产品。只有当技术既可靠又价格合理时，它才能真正有尊严地服务老年人。
structure: The two charts survey consumers' attitudes towards elderly-care robots... 39.3% fully accept, 32.8% partly accept, 27.9% reject; safety 46.30%, price 24.90%, convenience 10.70%.

The acceptance rate of over 70% reflects an aging population and heavier care burdens... robots can monitor health, remind users to take medicine or summon help... safety involves privacy, reliability and life-and-death decisions... price must remain affordable.

Elderly-care robots are a promising supplement, not a substitute for human company... safety data should be transparent and products easy for older users... only reliable and affordable technology can serve the elderly with dignity.
expressions: The two charts survey consumers' attitudes towards...
The pie chart shows that...
...while 27.9% reject the idea.
The bar chart ranks users' concerns.
Safety comes first at 46.30%, followed by price at 24.90%.
Several factors lie behind this pattern.
reflect a pressing reality
shoulder heavier burdens
struggle to care for elderly relatives around the clock
fill this gap
place safety above all else
remain affordable for ordinary households
a promising supplement, not a substitute for human company
make safety data transparent
Only when... can it...
traps: 图表作文要准确引用数据：三个接受度比例和三个关注点比例至少各引两项，不能只写“大多数人接受”“大家最关心安全”。
饼图与柱状图要分别描述，不能混为一谈：“接受度”是态度，“关注点”是顾虑，二者是不同维度。
解读要落到“人口老龄化与照护缺口”和“安全、价格是普及障碍”，不要偏成“机器人会取代子女”或“科技让人变懒”。
160–200 词，三段为宜；数据描述不要超过全文三分之一，重点应放在原因解读和评论上。
评论要客观平衡：肯定养老机器人的前景，也指出安全、价格与人文关怀的局限，不要写成产品广告或纯技术赞美。
